objdata.Name: 聚能山竹史诗任务 - 第二关

NameMultiLanguage.zh: 聚能山竹史诗任务 - 第二关

Lines.en: I have no idea why, but our Mangosteens brought us here.
Lines.zh: 不知道为什么，我们的山竹们故意把我们带到了这里。

Lines.en: Still remember how you got those mangosteens?
Lines.zh: 还记得你怎么拿到这些山竹的吗？

Lines.en: Still remember how those mangosteens are acting weird?
Lines.zh: 还记得这些山竹种种怪异举动吗？

Lines.en: Don't you think it's all a bit too good to be true?
Lines.zh: 你不觉得这一切都太巧了吗？

Lines.en: What if THAT mangosteen has been tricking you this entire time?
Lines.zh: 万一那只衫竹一直都在欺骗你们呢？

Lines.en: At least that lazy mangosteen isn't here...
Lines.zh: 至少那只衫竹现在不在……

Lines.en: Alert! User Dave, someone is trying to hack into my syst-
Lines.zh: 警告！用户戴夫，有人正在试图黑入我的系——

Lines.en: ...Are you sure about that? =)
Lines.zh: ……我真不在吗？=)

Lines.en: NOOOOOO! Leave me alone!
Lines.zh: 不！！！！你不要阴魂不散了好不好？

Lines.en: oh right im stuck on a level and I'll need some of your plants
Lines.zh: 哦对我卡关了说是，我从你这借点强力植物

Lines.en: I'll take this... and that... and that should be good enough~
Lines.zh: 带这个……再带上这个……好了差不多了~

Lines.en: Haha! Just as I ex-
Lines.zh: 哈哈！果不其——

Lines.en: I'm not gone yet lol screw you stupid zomboss get outta here
Lines.zh: 笑死我了我还没走呢，就你叫僵王是吧，滚出去！

Lines.en: ......Panney?
Lines.zh: ……潘妮？

Lines.en: Someone hacked me, User Dave. I didn't say what I just said.
Lines.zh: 我的系统被劫持了。刚才那些话不是我说的。

Lines.en: I detect no more zombies incoming, User Dave.
Lines.zh: 雷达显示不会有更多的僵尸了

Lines.en: Panney... I've been thinking...
Lines.zh: 潘妮……我一直在想……

Lines.en: How exactly did you find those mangosteens?
Lines.zh: 你到底是怎么找到这些山竹的？

Lines.en: I found them on the lawn right as I arrived at 2c...
Lines.zh: 我刚到中文版就看到草坪上有一大群山竹……

Lines.en: ... as if... they were waiting for my arrival...
Lines.zh: ……就像在专门等待我的到来一样……

BriefIntroduction.zh: 只是一只最普通的山竹……

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Survive a detrimental attack from the Kongfu Temple
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 在功夫世界的倾巢出动下存活

DescriptionsMultilanguage.en: Survive while SansGrinder borrowed some of your plants while Kongfu zombies team up against you
DescriptionsMultilanguage.zh: 在衫竹借走部分植物的情况下在三个派系的联手进攻中存活
